messages:
maya (eng-platform): quick ping — posted a draft for a metrics namespace + label naming proposal for runtime inputs (routing/policies/quotas). need initial feedback before Wed so we can lock for dashboards

Link: https://go/repo/metrics-namespace-draft (TL;DR below)

alex (eng-runtime): skimmed. big +1 on trying to standardize. main question: do we map raw OTel attributes directly -> prom labels or normalize?

maya (eng-platform): prefer normalization. OTel has lots of freeform attrs (model.hash, user_agent, request_id) — we should canonicalize to low-card labels for Prom and keep high-card data in traces/logs.

ryan (eng-infra): agree. need concrete rules. propose: 1) resource/service attrs -> prom labels (service, env) 2) route & policy -> labels but sanitized 3) model -> family + version (no full hash) 4) remove request_id, user_id from prom labels

samira (eng-ml): from model side: we do want model_variant sometimes (e.g., quantized vs fp16) — that’s low-card if we keep values like "q4_0", "fp16". model_family+variant+semver sounds right. avoid committing to model build ids in metrics though.

maya (eng-platform): proposed label list in draft: 
  - service (string)
  - env (prod/staging/dev)
  - route (sanitized path token, e.g., /v1/generate -> v1.generate)
  - routing_policy (latency/cost/availability)
  - quota_bucket (string)
  - model_family (redwood-7b, llama-2)
  - model_version (semver-like short)
  - model_variant (q4_0, fp16)
  - region (us-west-2)
  - capacity_tier (dedicated/shared)
  - gpu_class (a100, h100, none)
  - outcome (success/error/timeout)

maya (eng-platform): example metric names we recommend: 
  - redwood_runtime_requests_total{service,env,route,routing_policy,model_family,model_version}  
  - redwood_runtime_latency_bucket (histogram) with same label set

dawn (observability): question: how do we sanitize route? we have hundreds of distinct routes if we include full path params. also we use tags in console dashboards — should match label names.

alex (eng-runtime): sanitization rule idea: take the path, drop query, replace slashes with dots and replace numeric ids with "{id}" token, then collapse repeated tokens. e.g., /projects/123/models/abc -> projects.{id}.models.{id} -> projects.models.id (or projects.models)

samira (eng-ml): for cardinality guardrails: can we add a validation step on the metrics pipeline that rejects > X unique label values/week for a label key? infra-bot could notify owners.

ryan (eng-infra): yes. we can add a Prom relabeling + metric metadata job that tracks cardinality per label. proposed threshold: 500 unique values/week for a label in prod, alert if exceeded.

maya (eng-platform): we should also publish recommended label value enums for some keys (env, routing_policy, capacity_tier, outcome, gpu_class) so callers don't invent ad-hoc values. draft has suggested enums.

dawn (observability): dashboard implications: keep dashboards grouped by model_family and routing_policy. avoid per-route heatmaps unless route is in a curated allowlist. we can make a route-allowlist file maintained in repo.

alex (eng-runtime): internal API debate: should SDKs automatically attach these canonical labels or leave it to services? my vote: SDKs provide helpers + middleware that produce canonical labels, but service owners opt-in to attach them.

maya (eng-platform): agreed — provide middleware and a flag in our internal client: metrics.attach_runtime_labels=true. default false for now to avoid accidental cardinality spikes.

samira (eng-ml): quick note re: telemetry vs billing: some labels are needed for cost attribution (capacity_tier, gpu_class) — we must ensure those survive relabeling and are present before aggregation.

ryan (eng-infra): mark capacity_tier as cardinality-sensitive but low-card (shared/dedicated/burst). keep it. also ensure K8s node metadata mapping for gpu_class is reliable.

maya (eng-platform): small config example for OTel -> Prom mapping in draft (pseudo):
```
resource.attributes:
  service.name -> service
  deployment.environment -> env
span.attributes:
  net.host.name -> region
  custom.routing.policy -> routing_policy
  custom.model.family -> model_family
  custom.model.version -> model_version
relabeling:
  - source_labels: [route]
    action: replace
    regex: " /.*/([0-9]+).* "
    replacement: "{id}"
```

alex (eng-runtime): looks good. one more: metric name prefixes. prefer redwood_runtime_ vs rw_runtime_? longer but clearer.

maya (eng-platform): preference: redwood_runtime_ for public catalogs, internal experimental metrics can use redwood_alpha_.

dawn (observability): will update dashboards to reference the new label names once finalized. can we freeze names by Friday to get a small migration window next week?

maya (eng-platform): that's the plan. ask: owners, add comment in draft with any blockers. i'll collate and update by Thu EOD.

ryan (eng-infra): +1. infra-bot: create card to track implementation (metric mapping + relabeling + cardinality checks).

infra-bot: created issue RW-telemetry-142 in repo "telemetry" assigned to @ryan (eng-infra).

alex (eng-runtime): :thumbsup: will prototype middleware next week.

samira (eng-ml): I'll validate model labels for the most common families and send a short list.

maya (eng-platform): thanks all — please put any detailed comments on the draft.
